title: Your host needs “one more deposit”
scenario: A week before check-in, your vacation-rental host says the building introduced a refundable security deposit. The message uses the same friendly tone as earlier chats and asks for payment by bank transfer to the owner’s spouse.

answers.A: Ask the host to add the deposit formally to the reservation so it appears inside the platform.
answers.B: Transfer it because the host has been helpful for weeks and the deposit is refundable.
answers.C: Check the platform rules and reservation terms, then confirm any new deposit through platform support before paying.

explanation: Long, friendly communication builds trust, but new off-platform payments change the risk. Make the charge visible inside the booking system.
proTip: Relationship history should not bypass payment controls.
